results.title: Founded by Metsera backers, Sentivera emerges with $1.5B inflammatory disease deal
results.description: Having set Metsera on its journey to a $10 billion takeover, Arch Venture Partners and Population Health Partners have powered their new startup—Sentivera—to a licensing deal worth up to $1.5 billion.

results.title: Comstock becomes fully fledged recycler, clean energy company after selling mine assets to Mackay
results.description: NYSE-listed specialised metals recycler Comstock has closed the sale of all its mining assets in the historic Comstock Lode district of Nevada to TSX-V-listed Mackay Gold & Silver Corporation subsidiary Mackay Precious Metals for $45-million. Comstock has received $20-million of the consideration in cash and two-million common shares in Mackay Gold & Silver, valued at about $4.5-million, to which Comstock expects to record a gain in a range of about $10-million to $12-million. Another $7-million payment is due within 18 months.
